title: session_bundle member: manifest.json (produced by Stage 1; decision record 000 §2.2, D1)
description: The session bundle is a directory bundle (D1): manifest.json holds the manifest and metadata and indexes the other member files. The session bundle records raw facts only and makes no inference; the action↔API join is the deterministic responsibility of Stage 2 (D3).

session.description: Metadata describing this session itself (the metadata field of the session-bundle contract in design document 2: the system under test, the profile, session start/end, the auth context)

profile_ref.description: Identifier or path of the app_profile used

auth_context.description: Authentication context the session runs in

members.description: Index of the directory-bundle members. Member file names are frozen per D1.

har.description: Network traffic: standard HAR 1.2 + the custom _initiator field (D2); the per-file schema is session_bundle_har.schema.json

ui_action_log.description: One line per action; the schema of a single record is session_bundle_ui_action.schema.json

action_decision_log.description: Strategy-layer decision records, one per line; the schema of a single record is session_bundle_action_decision.schema.json

request_material_shapes.description: Optional for backward compatibility. B2 structured-redaction writers must emit this member and index it here. Each line validates against session_bundle_request_material_shape.schema.json.

page_state.description: Index of page_state/ snapshots. The contract freezes only the reference shape; the internal format of snapshot files is defined separately by the Stage 1 decision record (approved supplementary choice point 4).

action_id.description: ID of the associated ui_action_log action (the key moment the snapshot corresponds to)

format.description: Snapshot format tag (the concrete value table is frozen by the Stage 1 decision record)
